LESSON: THE FALL OF MAN

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.3: The Fall of Man

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Fall of Man. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to obey God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THE FALL OF MAN
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
The Fall of Man helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: THE FALL OF MAN
Study The Fall of Man like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “The Fall of Man” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what The Fall of Man is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “The Fall of Man” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach The Fall of Man to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11.
3. Make one local Kenya example of The Fall of Man from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for The Fall of Man: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study The Fall of Man?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to obey God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what The Fall of Man means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
